blocks.text: מַעֲרִיב לֵיל רִאשׁוֹן שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה.
פארבעטער:
בָּרְכוּ אֶת־יְיָ הַמְבֹרָךְ:
קו״ח
בָּרוּךְ יְיָ הַמְבֹרָךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
געמיינדע:

יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא שְׁמוֹ שֶׁל מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא שֶׁהוּא רִאשׁוֹן וְהוּא אַחֲרוֹן וּמִבַּלְעָדָיו אֵין אֱלֹהִים סֹלּוּ לָרֹכֵב בָּעֲרָבוֹת בְּיָהּ שְׁמוֹ וְעִלְזוּ לְפָנָיו. וּשְׁמוֹ מְרוֹמָם עַל־כָּל־בְּרָכָה וּתְהִלָּה:
בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
יְהִי שֵׁם יְיָ מְבֹרָךְ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם:

בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר בִּדְבָרוֹ מַעֲרִיב עֲרָבִים בְּחָכְמָה פּוֹתֵחַ שְׁעָרִים וּבִתְבוּנָה מְשַׁנֶּה עִתִּים וּמַחֲלִיף אֶת־הַזְּמַנִּים וּמְסַדֵּר אֶת־הַכּוֹכָבִים בְּמִשְׁמְרוֹתֵיהֶם בָּרָקִיעַ כִּרְצוֹנוֹ בּוֹרֵא יוֹם וָלָיְלָה גּוֹלֵל אוֹר מִפְּנֵי־חֹשֶׁךְ וְחֹשֶׁךְ מִפְּנֵי־אוֹר. וּמַעֲבִיר יוֹם וּמֵבִיא לָיְלָה וּמַבְדִּיל בֵּין יוֹם וּבֵין לָיְלָה יְיָ צְבָאוֹת שְׁמוֹ אֵל חַי וְקַיָּם תָּמִיד יִמְלוֹךְ עָלֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַמַּעֲרִיב עֲרָבִים:

אַהֲבַת עוֹלָם בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמְּךָ אָהָבְתָּ. תּוֹרָה וּמִצְוֹת חֻקִּים וּמִשְׁפָּטִים אוֹתָנוּ לִמַּדְתָּ, עַל־כֵּן יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּשָׁכְבֵנוּ וּבְקוּמֵנוּ נָשִׂיחַ בְּחֻקֶּיךָ. וְנִשְׂמַח בְּדִבְרֵי תוֹרָתֶךָ וּבְמִצְוֹתֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד, כִּי הֵם חַיֵּינוּ וְאֹרֶךְ יָמֵינוּ וּבָהֶם נֶהְגֶּה יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה. וְאַהֲבָתְךָ אַל־תָּסִיר מִמֶּנּוּ לְעוֹלָמִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אוֹהֵב עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל:
יחיד אומר
אֵל מֶלֶךְ נֶאֱמָן:
דברים ו ד
שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְהוָה אֶחָד:
בלחש
בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכָל־לְבָבְךָ וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁךָ וּבְכָל־מְאֹדֶךָ:
וְהָיוּ הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם עַל־

blocks.text: Evening Prayer for the New Year
Reader:
ברכו
Bless the Lord, who is called blessed.
Congregation:
Blessed is the Lord who is called blessed for ever. and ever.
Congregation:

Blessed and praised, glorified, exalted and extolled be the Name of the Supreme King of Kings, the Holy One blessed be He. He is the first and He is the last and beside Him there is no God. Make way before Him, who is enthroned above the clouds, Yah is his Name and rejoice before Him, His Name is exalted above all blessing and fame.
Blessed be His glorious royal Name for ever and ever.

Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God, King of the World, who by His word brings on the evening, opens the gates in wisdom, changes the times with understanding, alters the periods and orders the stars in their watches in the sky according to His will. He creates day and night, causes light to give way to darkness and darkness to light, leads away the day and brings on the night and distinguishes between day and night. The Lord of Hosts is His Name. The living and eternal God will constantly reign over us for ever and ever. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who brings on evenings.
אהבת

With eternal love dost Thou love Thy people, the House of Israel. Torah, commandments, statutes and judgments hast Thou taught us. Therefore, O Lord our God, when we lie down and when we arise, we will speak of Thy statutes. We rejoice in the words of Thy Torah and in Thy commandments for ever and ever, for they are our life and the length of our days and on them will we meditate day and night. Let not Thy love depart from us for all eternity. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who loves His people Israel.
(Deut. VI. 4)
Hear, O Israel, the Lord is our God, the Lord is One.
Blessed be His glorious royal Name for ever and ever.
ואהבת
You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your possession.
These words which I command you this day, shall be upon your heart.

blocks.text: לְבָבֶךָ:
וְשִׁנַּנְתָּם לְבָנֶיךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּרֶךְ וּבְשָׁכְבְּךָ וּבְקוּמֶךָ:
וּקְשַׁרְתָּם לְאוֹת עַל־יָדֶךָ וְהָיוּ לְטֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֶיךָ:
וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל־מְזֻזוֹת בֵּיתֶךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶיךָ:
דברים יא יג.
וְהָיָה אִם־שָׁמֹעַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶל־מִצְוֹתַי אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וּלְעָבְדוֹ בְּכָל־לְבַבְכֶם וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁכֶם:
וְנָתַתִּי מְטַר־אַרְצְכֶם בְּעִתּוֹ יוֹרֶה וּמַלְקוֹשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּ דְגָנֶךָ וְתִירֹשְׁךָ וְיִצְהָרֶךָ:
וְנָתַתִּי עֵשֶׂב בְּשָׂדְךָ לִבְהֶמְתֶּךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ:
הִשָּׁמְרוּ לָכֶם פֶּן־יִפְתֶּה לְבַבְכֶם וְסַרְתֶּם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם לָהֶם:
וְחָרָה אַף־יְהוָה בָּכֶם וְעָצַר אֶת־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה מָטָר וְהָאֲדָמָה לֹא תִתֵּן אֶת־יְבוּלָהּ וַאֲבַדְתֶּם מְהֵרָה מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ הַטֹּבָה אֲשֶׁר יְהוָה נֹתֵן לָכֶם:
וְשַׂמְתֶּם אֶת־דְּבָרַי אֵלֶּה עַל־לְבַבְכֶם וְעַל־נַפְשְׁכֶם וּקְשַׁרְתֶּם אֹתָם לְאוֹת עַל־יֶדְכֶם וְהָיוּ לְטוֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֵיכֶם:
וְלִמַּדְתֶּם אֹתָם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶם לְדַבֵּר בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּרֶךְ וּבְשָׁכְבְּךָ וּבְקוּמֶךָ:
וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל־מְזוּזוֹת בֵּיתֶךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶיךָ:
לְמַעַן יִרְבּוּ יְמֵיכֶם וִימֵי בְנֵיכֶם עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהוָה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם לָתֵת לָהֶם כִּימֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם עַל־הָאָרֶץ:
במדבר טו לז.
וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר:
דַּבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם וְעָשׂוּ לָהֶם צִיצִת עַל־כַּנְפֵי בִגְדֵיהֶם לְדֹרֹתָם וְנָתְנוּ עַל־צִיצִת הַכָּנָף פְּתִיל תְּכֵלֶת:
וְהָיָה לָכֶם לְצִיצִת וּרְאִיתֶם אֹתוֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֹת יְהוָה וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם

blocks.text: speak of them when you sit in your house and when you walk on the way, when you lie down and when you rise up.
You shall bind them for a sign upon your arm and they shall be frontlets between your eyes.
You shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gates.
(Deut. XI. 13)
And it shall happen if you listen carefully to My commandments which I command you today, to love the Lord your God and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul,
that I will grant the rain of your land in its season, the former rain and the latter rain, so that you will gather in your corn, your wine and your oil.
I will give grass to your field for your cattle, and you shall eat and be satisfied.
Take care that your heart be not deceived and that you do not turn aside and serve strange gods and bow down before them.

For then the wrath of the Lord will burn against you and He will close the heavens so that no rain shall fall and the earth shall not yield its produce, and you shall soon perish from the good land that the Lord is giving you.
Lay these words of mine upon your heart and upon your soul, bind them as a sign upon your arm and let them be frontlets between your eyes.
Teach them to your children by talking about them when you sit in your house and walk on the way and when you lie down and when you rise up.
You shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gates,
so that your days and the days of your children may increase upon the soil which the Lord has sworn to your fathers to give to them, as the days of the heavens above the earth.
(Numbers XV. 37)
Thus spoke the Lord to Moses:

Speak to the children of Israel and tell them to make themselves show-fringes upon the corners of their garments throughout their generations and to fasten to the fringe of each corner a thread of skyblue wool.

וְלֹא־תָתוּרוּ אַחֲרֵי לְבַבְכֶם וְאַחֲרֵי עֵינֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּם זֹנִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם:
לְמַעַן תִּזְכְּרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֹתָי וִהְיִיתֶם קְדֹשִׁים לֵאלֹהֵיכֶם:
אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי אֶתְכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם:
יש [לסמוך?] אלהיכם לאמת, לכן יתן ריוח מעט שלא יבלע הא׳.

אֱמֶת וֶאֱמוּנָה כָּל־זֹאת וְקַיָּם עָלֵינוּ כִּי הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְאֵין זוּלָתוֹ וַאֲנַחְנוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמּוֹ הַפּוֹדֵנוּ מִיַּד מְלָכִים מַלְכֵּנוּ הַגּוֹאֲלֵנוּ מִכַּף כָּל־הֶעָרִיצִים הָאֵל הַנִּפְרָע לָנוּ מִצָּרֵינוּ וְהַמְשַׁלֵּם גְּמוּל לְכָל־אוֹיְבֵי נַפְשֵׁנוּ. הָעֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת עַד אֵין חֵקֶר וְנִפְלָאוֹת עַד אֵין מִסְפָּר: הַשָּׂם נַפְשֵׁנוּ בַּחַיִּים וְלֹא־נָתַן לַמּוֹט רַגְלֵנוּ וְהַמַּדְרִיכֵנוּ עַל־בָּמוֹת אוֹיְבֵינוּ וַיָּרֶם קַרְנֵנוּ עַל־כָּל־שׂוֹנְאֵינוּ: הָעֹשֶׂה־לָּנוּ נִסִּים וּנְקָמָה בְּפַרְעֹה אוֹתוֹת וּמוֹפְתִים בְּאַדְמַת בְּנֵי־חָם:

הַמַּכֶּה בְעֶבְרָתוֹ כָּל־בְּכוֹרֵי מִצְרָיִם וַיּוֹצֵא אֶת־עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל מִתּוֹכָם לְחֵרוּת עוֹלָם: הַמַּעֲבִיר בָּנָיו בֵּין גִּזְרֵי יַם־סוּף אֶת־רוֹדְפֵיהֶם וְאֶת־שׂוֹנְאֵיהֶם בִּתְהוֹמוֹת טִבַּע: וְרָאוּ בָנָיו גְּבוּרָתוֹ שִׁבְּחוּ וְהוֹדוּ לִשְׁמוֹ וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בְרָצוֹן קִבְּלוּ עֲלֵיהֶם. מֹשֶׁה וּבְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ עָנוּ שִׁירָה בְּשִׂמְחָה רַבָּה וְאָמְרוּ כֻלָּם:
מִי־כָמֹכָה בָּאֵלִים יְהוָה מִי כָּמֹכָה נֶאְדָּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ נוֹרָא תְהִלֹּת עֹשֵׂה פֶלֶא:
מַלְכוּתְךָ רָאוּ בָנֶיךָ בּוֹקֵעַ יָם לִפְנֵי מֹשֶׁה זֶה אֵלִי עָנוּ וְאָמְרוּ:
יְהוָה יִמְלֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
וְנֶאֱמַר כִּי־פָדָה יְיָ אֶת־יַעֲקֹב וּגְאָלֹו מִיַּד חָזָק מִמֶּנּוּ.

Thus may you remember and fulfil all my commandments and be holy unto your God.
I am the Lord your God who led you out of the land of Egypt in order to be your God. I am the Lord your God.
אמת

All this is truth and faithfulness and it is established unto us that He, the Lord, is our God and there is none beside Him and we are Israel, His people. It is He who frees us from the hand of kings, our King who redeems us from the palm of all oppressors. It is God who requites our enemies on our behalf and pays retribution to all pursuers of our soul. It is He who performs unfathomable deeds of grandeur, wonders without number. He who sets our soul in the course of life and does not allow our feet to falter. He who leads us over the heights of our adversaries and raises our condition above all who hate us. It is He who effects wonders for us and revenge on Pharaoh, signs and miracles in the land of the sons of Ham,

who slays all the first-born of Egypt in His wrath and leads His people Israel from their midst to eternal freedom. It is He who causes His children to pass between the divisions of the Red Sea, their persecutors and their enemies did He drown in the depths. His children saw His strength, they praised and acknowledged His Name, they willingly accepted His dominion over them. Moses and the children of Israel answered in song to Thee with great rejoicing and they all said:
מי
Who is like Thee among the mighty, O Lord? Who is like Thee, glorious in holiness, awe-inspiring in fame, worker of wonder?
מלכותך
Thy children saw Thy kingdom when Thou didst divide the sea before Moses: this is my God, they answered and said:
The Lord shall reign for ever and ever.
ונאמר
And it is said: For the Lord has freed Jacob and redeemed him from the hand of one stronger than he.
Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who has redeemed Israel.
